summary: Two snow bike riders caught in an avalanche near West Lost Lake in the Flat Tops Wilderness area; one buried and killed
location: Near West Lost Lake, Flat Tops Wilderness area
notes: Reported in avalanche-center 2016-17 season index and CAIC classic 2016-17 table (02/14: 2 snow bike riders caught, 1 buried and killed, near West Lost Lake, Flat Tops Wilderness area); county set to Garfield via West Lost Lake reverse-geocode. Survivor detail (Unofficial Networks, via Steamboat Pilot): the second rider, Sean Tyler Searle of Franktown, dug himself out, performed unsuccessful CPR on his partner, and was found exhausted ~4:15 p.m. by SAR personnel following boot tracks and a "HELP" arrow etched in the snow; the deceased victim's body was recovered the next morning. run 671: SnowBrains timbersled article, parent-opened
